answer: Two Transportation Security Administration screeners have been fired after conspiring to grope attractive men at Denver International Airport, Denver police said. Police say the female officer would tell the screening machine that a female passenger -- not a male -- was walking through, triggering an anomaly in the groin area and prompting the male officer to pat down the passenger. Investigator Chris Higgins watched the plan being carried out on February 9 and interviewed the female TSA officer, who said she had done this with her colleague at least 10 other times, police said. But it's unlikely criminal charges will be filed because there is no identifiable victim.
